text:
Alex: Morning all — quick async standup. What I did: deployed micro-evict tuning to canary (us-west). Observed ~3% extra 5xx in the canary window; rolled back. Blockers: need to adjust eviction TTL param and get a quick eyes-on PR #4822. Today: wire up alert suppression for warmup spikes and follow up on oncall notes.
Priya: Oncall update: saw 2 warmup-induced pages overnight, both resolved by increasing batch timeout. Created ticket SRE-624 to track suppression work. Pinged @Miguel for context on the pager schedule.
Miguel: Ack, saw the pages. Confirm they were cache-warmup related. I muted one alert rule for the night to reduce noise. Shared a small query to detect warmup spikes:
```
count_over_time(alerts{alertname="kv_high_5xx",env="prod"}[10m]) > 5
```
Taylor: I’ll take PR review for #4822 today and propose a config tweak: `eviction_ttl_ms = 60000` -> `90000` for slow tail workloads. Also will add a canary metric to the dashboard for clearer rollback signals.
Alex: Thanks — @Taylor please post the proposed config diff inline so @Miguel can sanity-check before I re-release. Also re: suppression, let's add a 10m 'grace' window on new instances only (so we don't suppress genuine regressions).
Miguel: Sounds good. For the automation piece, ops-bot shows the rollout job failed once due to a flaky subnet attach. Logged vendor ticket VND-108; will follow up with infra.
ops-bot: Deploy job 8672 failed in `us-west-2` at 2026-03-16T23:45:12Z — reason: ENI attach timeout. Link: https://ci.redwood/dashboard/job/8672
Priya: SRE-624 created: https://jira.redwood/browse/SRE-624 — includes steps to add suppression rule + test plan. Assigned to Taylor. ETA EOD.
Alex: Quick check — any blockers for handoff tonight?
Miguel: none after mute and filing VND-108.
Priya: I’ll run through the handoff doc and add a short checklist: mute rules, rollback steps, who to page.
Alex: OK. If no objections I'll schedule the config change for a small canary at 10:30 PDT. :thumbsup:
Taylor: :thumbsup: will post PR link in this thread when ready.
Alex: Closing — thanks everyone.
